svg.title: Metadata access closes and tokens are revoked
svg.desc: Block metadata access at its boundary and revoke token objects in distinct systems. Access-path closure and credential invalidation are different protective operations. Visual distinction: A solid tiled network wall with disconnected cable ends. Indicates unavailable reach, not a decision awaiting human approval.
